pages.text: In Phase 6 the air freezes onto the surface as thin crystalline sheets. Mine them for $(bold)Frozen Atmosphere Shards$().$(br2)$(bold)Used in:$() the $(l:advanced/transponder)Transponder$(/l) and the $(l:orsa_equipment/o2_canisters)O2 Canister Mk.III$(/l). You will need several.
$(italic)You are holding the sky. ORSA recommends not thinking about it.$()

pages.title: Sublimation
pages.text: If your body temperature is above $(bold)-150°C$(), a carried shard sublimates. It shimmers and sheds snowflakes, then vanishes after about $(bold)7.5 seconds$().$(br2)A $(l:heating/thermal_container)Thermal Container$(/l) stops the timer. Stored shards keep indefinitely.

pages.title: Procedure
pages.text: $(li)Mine the shard$(li)Open your Thermal Container$(li)Put the shard inside$(li)Do not panic$(li)If you panicked, see step 4$(br2)$(italic)"A rescue beacon that needs frozen sky. In hindsight, copper wire would have worked." -- Dr. Vasquez$()
